1.w: A psalm by Asaph. Certainly God is good to Israel, and to those whose motives are pure.

2.w: But as for me, my feet almost slipped; my feet almost slid out from under me.

3.w: For I envied those who are proud, as I observed the prosperity of the wicked.

4.w: For they suffer no pain; their bodies are strong and well fed.

5.w: They are immune to the trouble common to men; they do not suffer as other men do.

6.w: Arrogance is their necklace, and violence covers them like clothing.

7.w: Their prosperity causes them to do wrong; their thoughts are sinful.

8.w: They mock and say evil things; they proudly threaten violence.

9.w: They speak as if they rule in heaven, and lay claim to the earth.

10.w: Therefore they have more than enough food to eat and even suck up the water of the sea.

11.w: They say, “How does God know what we do? Is the Most High aware of what goes on?”

12.w: Take a good look. This is what the wicked are like, those who always have it so easy and get richer and richer.

13.w: I concluded, “Surely in vain I have kept my motives pure and maintained a pure lifestyle.

14.w: I suffer all day long and am punished every morning.”

15.w: If I had publicized these thoughts, I would have betrayed your people.

16.w: When I tried to make sense of this, it was troubling to me.

17.w: Then I entered the precincts of God’s temple and understood the destiny of the wicked.

18.w: Surely you put them in slippery places; you bring them down to ruin.

19.w: How desolate they become in a mere moment. Terrifying judgments make their demise complete.

20.w: They are like a dream after one wakes up. O Lord, when you awake you will despise them.

21.w: Yes, my spirit was bitter, and my insides felt sharp pain.

22.w: I was ignorant and lacked insight; I was as senseless as an animal before you.

23.w: But I am continually with you; you hold my right hand.

24.w: You guide me by your wise advice, and then you will lead me to a position of honor.

25.w: Whom do I have in heaven but you? On earth there is no one I desire but you.

26.w: My flesh and my heart may grow weak, but God always protects my heart and gives me stability.

27.w: Yes, look! Those far from you die; you destroy everyone who is unfaithful to you.

28.w: But as for me, God’s presence is all I need. I have made the Sovereign Lord my shelter, as I declare all the things you have done.
